description: Restyle this climber as a different, much younger man in his early twenties: no beanie hat and no big beard. A slim youthful face with light olive skin, thick dark eyebrows and a faint, light stubble shadow along the jaw and chin (subtle, not a full beard or moustache). He has pitch black hair in a shaggy mod cut: thick and full, with heavy straight bangs falling over the forehead to the eyebrows, the sides covering the tops of the ears, and the back a little longer, tousled, reaching down past the nape to the collar. Small silver hoop earrings. He wears a navy blue zip-up track jacket with a white stripe across the chest, open over a white t-shirt, and light blue jeans. Keep the climbing harness, rope, backpack, boots, pose and pixel art style exactly.
